name: Sir William Tyree Engineering Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Multi-year scholarship for rural or remote first-year UQ engineering students with an interest in electrical engineering.
key: $15,000 per year for up to 4 years.
who: Domestic student from rural or remote Australia (RA2-5).
Commencing full-time in the first year of the BE(Hons), BE(Hons)/Master of Engineering, or an engineering dual.
how: Apply using the online form with a cover letter, resume, Year 12 report, ATAR Advice Notice and evidence of financial hardship.

source.label: UQ Scholarships: Sir William Tyree Engineering Scholarship
